title: Cache-write breakdowns and cost coverage with one priced and one unpriced model
matrix: input, output, cache-read and cache-write breakdowns
policy: P9 (decided on #58): when the 5m + 1h breakdown doesn't add up to cache_creation_input_tokens, the flat total is the quantity and its tier is unresolved. Its cost is a minimum at the cheaper tier's rate, kept apart from the known cost, so the model's cost is partial.
derivation: Haiku 4.5: a [100, 50, 5m 200, 1h 100, read 1000]; b [10, 5, 5m 40] (no breakdown); c [1, 1] with total 300 but breakdown 100 + 100 -> 300 tier-unresolved. Sum [111, 56, 240, 100, 1000, 3] + 300 unresolved = 1807. claude-test-1 d [5, 5] = 10, unpriced. Haiku 4.5 list prices per million: input $1, output $5, 5m write $1.25, 1h write $2, read $0.10 -> known 111 + 280 + 300 + 200 + 100 = 991 micro-dollars = $0.000991; minimum for c's 300 at the cheaper 5m rate = 375 micro-dollars = $0.000375. Together $0.001366 is a lower bound (assuming the flat total is right), the amount reported as complete before the P9 decision. Haiku is now partial; 10 tokens unknown, so the month is partial.
